title: MOS driver

sources.document: TI The Interface Circuits Data Book 2nd ed. 1974, SN75361A dual TTL-to-MOS driver (bulletin DL-S 7312054, Sep 1973, tentative data sheet)

pins.name: E
pins.text: enable common to both drivers (input of both NAND gates)

pins.name: 1Y
pins.text: MOS-level output swinging to near VCC2

functions.text: Datasheet positive logic Y = (AE)'. Output high is close to VCC2.

electrical.notes: VCC1 4.75-5.25 V, VCC2 4.75-24 V (nominal 20 V), TA 0-70 C. VOH min VCC2-1 V at IOH -50 uA, VCC2-2.3 V at -10 mA; VOL max 0.3 V at IOL 10 mA, 0.5 V at 40 mA (VCC2 15-24 V). Output clamp VCC2+1.5 V. Inputs VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V; IIL A -1.6 mA, E -3.2 mA. outputMaxVoltageV is the VCC2 maximum.

timing.conditions: VCC1 5 V, VCC2 20 V, TA 25 C, CL 390 pF, RD 10 ohm
VCC1 5 V, VCC2 20 V, TA 25 C, CL 390 pF, RD 10 ohm

timingLimits.text: tDLH 11 typ / 20 max ns, tDHL 10 typ / 18 max ns (delay to start of output edge)
tTLH 25 typ / 40 max ns, tTHL 21 typ / 35 max ns, CL 390 pF

unknown: No recommended IOL/IOH are given; output figures exist only as VOH/VOL test conditions (in notes), so the current fields are null.
Datasheet read is the SN75361A (tentative 1973 sheet); a datasheet for a plain SN75361 was not found.
